svg.title: K44 · The checklist: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 44: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service cart (one stable address); Pods cart (0) (none created, no paperwork). Also: Namespace guard (enforce: restricted, a four-item checklist). Your mission: What is on the checklist, and what is missing?

svg.text: The gate does not say "no". It hands you a checklist, and your kitchen cart ticks none of it.
